name: Yashiro Mamori
source:
Miko who manages the Takemori shrine.

An attractive girl who exudes gentleness; delicate, but has large breasts. 

She has a weak constitution but has a tomboy personality since she was raised in the mountains.

She is also somewhat of a natural airhead and ends up committing mistakes frequently.

She loves to try out food at different places and has a weakness for information related to gourmet food. She has a large appetite but stays thin.

Weapon: Bow

[Translated from [url=https://www.debonosu.jp/debo/game/reimeiki_19/index.html#character]Official Website[/url]]
